puppies-kittens.prompt:
a cute toy creature, not a person: a puppy, a kitten, an octopus, a little robot,
or a creature of its own. big head, big eyes, a strong expression, one big prop
that tells its trade. simple cartoon shapes, a thick clean outline, flat colour
with 2 tones of shading. the whole crew shares one skin colour, bright cartoon
yellow, like a cartoon family where everybody is yellow. matte toy plastic.
one flat shape behind the head on a plain dark backdrop.

a square concept sheet with four separate square portraits in an exact 2 by 2 grid. each cell is 1024 pixels square, total 2048 by 2048. puppies and kittens crew direction. top left: floppy-eared puppy engineer with a huge wrench and a focused grin. top right: broad kitten gunner with a single chunky cannon prop and a fierce scowl. bottom left: pointy-eared kitten haggler with a huge coin and a knowing wink. bottom right: short-muzzled puppy pilot with a big steering yoke and an eager grin. all fur and exposed creature surfaces are bright cartoon yellow. nonhuman animal anatomy. meadow palette for props and clothes: soft red, pastel green, butter yellow, rose, milk white. dark forest green backdrop. one flat coloured disc behind each head. each character and prop stays within its own cell with generous margins. no letters or labels. the attached user reference supplies only the playful toy feel; copy no shape from it.
